name: yumilin92/tokyo-airbnb-nlp

name: jmjung950312-cmd/seoul-airbnb-revpar-optimization
what_it_holds: 32,061 Seoul Airbnb listings across all 25 districts, explicitly sourced from Inside Airbnb (Seoul), covering Oct 2024-Sep 2025; repo has a data/ directory with raw + processed files and notebooks 00-06 (EDA through LightGBM ADR/occupancy prediction and K-Means clustering into 4 market segments). 11 commits, no license stated, low stars.
why_useful: Seoul is an APAC market outside our current Inside Airbnb 13-city + 120-market panels; a 32k-listing Seoul dataset with RevPAR fields would be a real gap-filler if it holds a genuine listings+calendar extract (needs directory check).
themes: APAC STR datasets: Tokyo/Kyoto minpaku registration data, Seoul, Bangkok, Bali, Sydney/Melbourne, Auckland, Singapore, Hong Kong Airbnb data and regulation
why_all: Seoul is an APAC market outside our current Inside Airbnb 13-city + 120-market panels; a 32k-listing Seoul dataset with RevPAR fields would be a real gap-filler if it holds a genuine listings+calendar extract (needs directory check).

Seoul is not in our held 13-city Inside Airbnb panel; this is a recent (2024-25) committed snapshot with ADR/occupancy fields for an APAC market outside our current coverage, useful if the live Inside Airbnb Seoul dump has already rolled off the ~1-year CDN retention window.

name: Florida-Airbnb (CrystalVF)
what_it_holds: Capstone project analyzing Broward County (Fort Lauderdale, used as a South Florida / Miami-area proxy) Inside Airbnb data, snapshot dated 2025-06-24. data/raw/ has listings.csv.gz and calendar.csv.gz committed directly to the repo (plus a DATA_SOURCE_LINKS.md); data/clean/ is empty placeholders. README frames it around ADR, occupancy rate, RevPAL as KPIs. R/SQL/scripts folders for the analysis pipeline.
why_useful: A committed, single-date Inside Airbnb snapshot for a Florida sunbelt market (Broward/South Florida) we do not explicitly hold in our 13-city or 120-market cohorts; could extend geographic coverage for gap-relevant Florida ADR/occupancy checks, though it is only one snapshot date and duplicates our existing Inside Airbnb methodology rather than adding a new data type.
duplicate_of_holding: Same Inside Airbnb source/methodology we already hold for other cities, but this specific Florida market and date are not in our current panel
themes: US sunbelt and mountain STR markets datasets: Florida (Orlando, Miami, Tampa), Arizona (Scottsdale, Sedona), Texas, Colorado (Breckenridge, Denver), Tennessee (Gatlinburg), Great Smoky Mountains
why_all: A committed, single-date Inside Airbnb snapshot for a Florida sunbelt market (Broward/South Florida) we do not explicitly hold in our 13-city or 120-market cohorts; could extend geographic coverage for gap-relevant Florida ADR/occupancy checks, though it is only one snapshot date and duplicates our existing Inside Airbnb methodology rather than adding a new data type.

name: junheecho/crawl-inside-airbnb
what_it_holds: Small script to download all files listed on insideairbnb.com/get-the-data.html (i.e., automates a full bulk pull of every city/vintage currently exposed on the Inside Airbnb CDN in one run).
why_useful: Not new data, but a ready one-command method to snapshot the entire current Inside Airbnb catalogue at once (all cities, not just our 13); useful for scheduling a fuller point-in-time capture going forward, and to check for markets/vintages we don't currently pull.
time_coverage: current CDN snapshot only, not historical
duplicate_of_holding: overlaps our own Inside Airbnb pull tooling; only useful if it broadens city coverage beyond our 13-city/120-market panel
themes: Inside Airbnb historical dump mirrors and archives (pre-2023 listings/calendar/reviews CSVs committed or released; archive.org mirrors referenced from GitHub)
